note: Hand-checked expectations for the first 200 rows of the provided dataset. Used to sanity-check the pipeline, not as training data.

expectations.check: Edmonton mentions resolve mostly to place_role = help_from, not affected
expectations.why: Edmonton sent aid; it was not flooded

expectations.check: Tweets containing #job or #hiring classify as relevant = false
expectations.why: Spam reusing the event hashtag is the main noise source

expectations.check: Canada Day and sports chatter classify as relevant = false

expectations.why: Ambiguous name; the bounding box should decide it

expectations.check: Retweets carry the classification of the tweet they quote
expectations.why: 2,225 rows, classified once via the duplicate group

expectations.check: Rescue and stranded reports classify as urgency = critical
expectations.why: Drives the red pins and the brief headline

expectations.check: Eyewitness reports are never flagged as claims needing verification
expectations.why: Residents are not expected to be authoritative

expectations.check: A tweet with no resolvable place stays in the feed and table but is not plotted
